224:t_10:34.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Can I... really stay your big brother?」

224:t_10:35.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Of course you can! Big Bro is Big Bro, after all!」

224:t_10:36.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Promise you'll come back safe, Big Bro. This time I'll bake the pineapple cake for both my big bros.」

224:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...She has grown into a fine young woman.」

224:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That $$ランカ$$ grew into such a bright and honest young woman is thanks to your efforts, $$オズマ$$.」

224:t_10:41.en:
$$オズマ$$
「...That's not it. All I ever did was make up for taking her smile away.」

224:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please do not belittle yourself like that. If you run down your own family, $$ランカ$$ will surely be saddened.」

224:t_10:44.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all. I am one of $$ランカ$$'s fans too, after all.」

224:t_10:46.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I know. $$ランカ$$ will soon fly the nest...」

224:t_10:47.en:
$$オズマ$$
「When that time comes, the one at her side won't be me or $$ブレラ$$. And whoever it turns out to be, it surely isn't my place to butt in.」

224:t_10:48.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As her brother, as a man, as her commanding officer... It must be quite complicated for you.」

224:t_10:49.en:
$$オズマ$$
「But it doesn't feel bad. ...To watch over her on that day, I'm going to make it back alive.」

224:t_10:51.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, let's get pumped up! Let's go all out again today...」

224:t_10:52.en:
$$オズマ$$
「For business, business! Extreme Fire! Bomber!!」

224:t_10:53.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「An explosion for a punchline, of all things!?」

225:t_000:0.en:
$$ランカ$$
「So this is the ruins of the $$プロトカルチャー$$...」

225:t_000:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「I hear this planet is hidden in a gas cloud, and isn't even recorded in the observation data.」

225:t_000:2.en:
$$ランカ$$
「On a planet like that, what did they build this for, I wonder...」

225:t_000:3.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「According to Chief of Staff $$エキセドル$$, this type of ruin seems to be some kind of recording device.」

225:t_000:4.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Then I was right... They built it to leave something behind.」

225:t_000:5.en:
$$ランカ$$
「And they built it even though it might never reach anyone...」

225:t_000:7.en:
$$シン$$
「So why did you volunteer for the ruins exploration team too, $n?」

225:t_000:8.en:
$n
「Ruins of a prehistoric civilization? As an occult fan, I can't just sit this one out.」

225:t_000:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「As expected of 《$$ナイト$$》. Ditto for me.」

225:t_000:10.en:
$$レド$$
「What is this 'Knight'? It seems to be another name for $n.」

225:t_000:12.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「You're pretty open about it. A lot of people hide that kind of thing as their $$黒歴史$$.」

225:t_000:14.en:
$$キラ$$
「In the $$ＡＤＷ$$, the word $$黒歴史$$ is used to mean a past you want to hide.」

225:t_000:15.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Huh... Change the world and the words change too, I guess.」

225:t_000:16.en:
$n
「I have no intention of hiding it.」

225:t_000:17.en:
$n
(...It's the name Sis gave me, after all...)

225:t_000:18.en:
$$シン$$
「That doesn't mean you can drag $$セツコ$$ along too! You planning to play the lucky guy with Miss $$スズネ$$ and $$セツコ$$ on both arms?」

225:t_000:20.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Calm down, $$シン$$. $$セツコ$$ volunteered on her own.」

225:t_000:22.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Y-yes... I was a little curious too.」

225:t_000:29.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「That $n sure has gotten mouthy.」

225:t_000:30.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「It shows how much he's grown since the $$時獄戦役$$.」

225:t_000:32.en:
$$キラ$$
「Let's leave it there, $$シン$$. $$ルナマリア$$ is about to get upset.」

225:t_000:34.en:
$$アマタ$$
「But it's just a survey, and we're committing all our forces to it.」

225:t_000:35.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「On top of that, every ship except the $$クォーター$$ is on standby in the upper atmosphere.」

225:t_000:37.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Are you sensing something, my friend?」

225:t_000:38.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Yes... I'm sure $n and $$セツコ$$ feel the same.」

225:t_000:40.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Is $$セツコ$$ feeling something about these ruins too...?)

225:t_000:41.en:
$$スズネ$$
($n and $$セツコ$$ have something in common... The $$スフィア$$...)

225:t_000:42.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Then what am I uneasy about, when I'm not a Reactor...?)

225:t_000:44.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Got it. Leave the guiding to me and $$ガムリン$$, since we've been inside before.」

225:t_000:45.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Somehow, $$ミレーヌ$$... you seem to be in a good mood.」

225:t_000:47.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
(Because the ruins on $$惑星ラクス$$ are where $$ガムリン$$ first called me by just my name...)

225:t_000:50.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Nothing... Just thinking you look awfully slack-faced.」

225:t_000:52.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「M-Miss $$ミレーヌ$$, that's enough. Let's head to the ruins.」

225:t_000:53.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Heh heh... So it's 'Miss' today.」

225:t_000:56.en:
$$アルト$$
「They've got a nice mood between them, Captain $$ガムリン$$ and $$ミレーヌ$$...」

225:t_000:58.en:
$$アルト$$
「Did that cheer you up a little, $$ランカ$$?」

kept_omissions: 225:t_000:16: 'I have no intention of hiding it' - 'it' (the alias) settled by the row before, nothing omitted that matters
225:t_000:50: Basara's subject 'I' kept implicit via 'Just thinking'; fine in casual English
uncertain: 225:t_000:52-53: Gamlin's ミレーヌさん rendered 'Miss Mylene' (not dropped) because Mylene's next line jokes about his さん付け; 'So it's 'Miss' today' is the English stand-in. Banagher/Mylene's other さん forms dropped as usual.
225:t_000:9/10: 《ナイト》 link uses $$ナイト$$ (Knight); Ledo's unbracketed ナイト君 also uses the token in plain speech. Nickname kept plain 'Knight' without a君 equivalent.

225:t_000:12-14: 黒歴史 rendered with the glossary token ($$黒歴史$$ = Black History); the Gundam-style joke (past you want to hide) still reads via Kira's explanation, but Loran's reaction line is just the token.
224:t_10:40/42/46: AG's 様 dropped; AG addresses Ozma by name. 224:t_10:42 'run down your own family' - Ozma himself is that family, reading of ご自分の家族をけなされたら assumed.

224:t_10:52: Ozma finishing AG's 張り切って... with 商売、商売！過激にファイヤー！ボンバー！！ rendered as 'For business, business! Extreme Fire! Bomber!!' (Fire Bomber catchphrase; AG's next line points at the explosion gag).
225:t_000:36/39/48: nine-dot '.........' per settled rule. 225:t_000:57 Jigoku 'Okay...' replaced with 'Yeah...' to fit reply to Alto.
225:t_000:41: スフィア token in plain prose as $$スフィア$$; 225:t_000:42 bare リアクター = plain 'Reactor' (as in slices 2029).
